title: Vector Embedding Dimension Mismatch
summary: Embedding model checkpoint upgraded from 768-dim to 1536-dim without reindexing, causing 0-similarity fallbacks. Automated PR restored compatible embedding client.

title: Cross-Encoder Reranker CPU Throttling
summary: Reranker batch size was set to 64 on 2-CPU worker pods. Automated PR tuned batch size to 16 with thread pool bounding.
